clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, the Glyphic Scroll calls newly raised Forsaken magi to the church. Isabella’s seal marks the summons, which invites fledgling spellcasters to begin their arcane training in undeath.

Newly awakened Forsaken mages find a sealed scroll after culling mindless Scourge in Deathknell’s graveyard. Isabella, the settlement’s mage trainer, marks it with her seal and calls them to the ruined parish sanctuary. There, new magi begin learning the arcane under the Forsaken banner. Death has freed them from mortal weakness, but magic’s corrupting temptations remain.
